// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A typed function per route of each HTTP server, sending its arguments and
// decoding its result as the servers' JSON. Framework-neutral: hooks.ts adds
// React on top.

import type * as $t from "./types";

// [react]'s api_base, which each route's path goes after.
export const $base = "";

/** Runs proc Main: `POST /api/main` on http server web-api. */
export async function main(args: { readonly n: number; readonly verbose: boolean; readonly name: string }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<string> {
  const v = await $call("POST", "/api/main", {
    "n": $encInt(args.n),
    "verbose": $encBool(args.verbose),
    "name": $encString(args.name),
  }, opts);
  return $decString(v, "result");
}

export function $enc_MainArgs(x: $t.MainArgs): unknown {
  return {
    "n": $encInt(x.n),
    "verbose": $encBool(x.verbose),
    "name": $encString(x.name),
  };
}

export function $dec_MainArgs(v: unknown, at: string): $t.MainArgs {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    n: $decInt($field(o, "n", at), at + ".n"),
    verbose: $decBool($field(o, "verbose", at), at + ".verbose"),
    name: $decString($field(o, "name", at), at + ".name"),
  };
}

==== hooks.ts
// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A React hook per route of each HTTP server, over client.ts: each gives the
// route's last result or error and whether a call is in flight, and cancels
// calls that are no longer wanted.

import * as React from "react";
import * as $c from "./client";

/**
 * Runs proc Main through main (`POST /api/main` on http server web-api): with
 * args, whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useMain(args?: { readonly n: number; readonly verbose: boolean; readonly name: string } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly n: number; readonly verbose: boolean; readonly name: string }, string> {
  return $useCall($c.main, args, opts);
}
